cst_options_lua_networking_desc: Slower than native. Turn on only if you have connection problems.
cst_options_desc: Choose which CST features you use.
cst_options_enabled_desc: Host: CST for the whole lobby, and which features clients may use. Client: your own CST features.
cst_options_hostage_desc: Civilians and guards you tied or controlled.
cst_options_drill_desc: Drills and saws you placed or repaired.
cst_options_prop_desc: Windows and props you damaged, the noise from breaking them, and map objects you used, such as the hidden-room bookshelf on Framing Frame day 3 or a wire box on Firestarter day 2.
cst_options_npc_desc: NPCs alerted by your targets, and the alerts they spread.
cst_options_intimidation_desc: Intimidate guards and civilians the moment your targets alert them.
cst_options_dart_desc: Darted guards are instantly dazed on hit and slower to detect your targets.
cst_options_camera_loop_desc: Looped cameras immediately stop detecting your targets once the loop starts.
cst_options_bag_handling_desc: Pick up, throw and secure bags and loot without lag.
cst_options_bag_secure_desc: Bags you throw into a loot drop on your screen are secured even if the host's copy of the bag missed it.
cst_options_equipment_desc: Clientside ECM camera jamming. Other deployables also work without lag.
cst_keybind_ownership_debug_desc: Debug: highlight client-owned detection targets in their owner's color.
cst_keybind_runtime_desc: Same as Enable ClientsideStealth in mod options. Host: the whole lobby. Client: your own CST features.
cst_status_pause_cancelled_host_busy: CST pause cancelled: host is busy
cst_status_pause_cancelled_peer_timeout: CST pause cancelled: peer did not acknowledge
cst_status_resume_unconfirmed_peer_timeo: CST resume unconfirmed: peer did not acknowledge
cst_status_pause_cancelled_peer_joined: CST pause cancelled: peer joined during preparation
cst_status_pause_cancelled_peer_busy: CST pause cancelled: peer is busy
cst_status_client_pause_requested: Client CST pause requested; waiting for safe handoff
cst_status_settings_saved_host_paused: CST settings saved; host has CST paused
cst_status_pause_pending_transactions: CST pause pending: finishing active transactions
cst_status_client_disabled: Client CST disabled; vanilla host detection enabled for you
cst_status_toggle_pending_transaction: CST toggle pending: active bag or equipment transaction
cst_reason_switching: Pending: switching connections with the other players.
cst_reason_pending: Pending: waiting for the host to confirm.
cst_reason_paused: Paused: the host paused CST for the lobby.
cst_reason_host_disabled: Unavailable: the host turned this feature off.
cst_reason_dependency: Unavailable: it needs a feature the host turned off.
cst_reason_no_host: Unavailable: the host isn't running CST, or hasn't answered yet.
cst_reason_no_source: Unavailable: turn on at least one target other than Alerted NPCs.
cst_lobby_desc: See who in the lobby runs CST and which features they use.
cst_lobby_missing_desc: This player hasn't answered CST. They may not have the mod, or are still joining.
cst_lobby_waiting: Waiting for this player's feature choices.
cst_lobby_uses_all: Uses every feature the host allows.
cst_rpc_restart_desc:
CST was enabled or updated while the game was running. Restart PAYDAY 2 to enable its native connection.

Until then, CST still works using Lua fallback networking.
